A group of '''marauding Dark Jedi''' were known to roam the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Their raids were brought to an end when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] intervened, leading a strike team of fellow Knights in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="RPGRCR" /> C'baoth's victory over the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] ultimately led to his assuming the title of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]],<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> a claim the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] recognized as valid.<ref name="RPGRCR" /> Many years later, it was thought that C'baoth had in fact defeated a Dark Jedi insurrection in the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] instead, while that particular event was actually the work of the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[1992]] novel ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', Jorus C'baoth was credited with defeating a Dark Jedi insurrection on [[Bpfassh]] between the years 77 and 74 "Pre-Empire" (P.E.). The book also mentions C'baoth assumed the title of Jedi Master that same year 74 P.E.<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> However, after the date of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was set between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], this became impossible. In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' credited [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] with opposing the Bpfasshi darksiders, stating that legend had distorted truth.<ref name="CSWE" /> However, the [[2002]] sourcebook ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'' had already established its own [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]], by stating C'baoth had settled a Dark Jedi insurrection in the Elrood sector, a few years before the Battle of Naboo.<ref name="RPGRCR" />
